org.description: A non-profit, non-partisan child-focused organisation supporting vulnerable children, teenage mothers and children with special needs in Uganda through education, holistic care, protection and sustainable livelihoods.

pages.title: Boundless Gracia Children's Foundation — Extending Grace. Restoring Hope. Transforming Lives.
pages.description: Boundless Gracia Children's Foundation supports vulnerable children, teenage mothers and children with special needs in Kyegegwa District, Uganda, through education, health, protection and household livelihoods.

pages.title: Our Story — Boundless Gracia Children's Foundation
pages.description: Founded in 2024 by Asiimwe Eunice, Boundless Gracia was born from a desire to extend compassion and practical support to children and families facing difficult circumstances.

pages.title: Vision, Mission, Values & Objectives — Boundless Gracia Children's Foundation
pages.description: Our vision and mission, the six core values we are tested against, our five objectives and the four programme areas that deliver them.

pages.title: Our Team — Boundless Gracia Children's Foundation
pages.description: The Board of Trustees, the Board of Directors and the Senior Management Team of Boundless Gracia Children's Foundation, and what each role is accountable for.

pages.description: How the Foundation is governed, how money is controlled, and the safeguarding rules that protect every child we work with.

pages.title: Our Impact — Boundless Gracia Children's Foundation
pages.description: The targets we have committed to for 2026–2030, how each one is counted, and the reports and audited accounts we publish against them.

pages.title: Our Work — Boundless Gracia Children's Foundation
pages.description: Four programme areas delivered as a single package: education and child development, health and nutrition, child protection, and community livelihoods.

pages.title: Grace to Learn — Education & Child Development | Boundless Gracia
pages.description: Child sponsorship, scholastic support, early childhood development, remedial learning, vocational and technical training, mentorship and life skills.

pages.title: Grace to Thrive — Health, Nutrition & WASH | Boundless Gracia
pages.description: Community health outreaches, nutrition screening and supplementary feeding, immunisation and maternal referral, safe water, sanitation and hygiene.

pages.title: Grace to Belong — Child Protection & Family Strengthening | Boundless Gracia
pages.description: Protecting children from abuse, neglect, exploitation, child labour, trafficking and early marriage through prevention, case management and family-based care.

pages.title: Grace to Rise — Livelihoods & Economic Empowerment | Boundless Gracia
pages.description: Savings groups, enterprise and financial literacy training, start-up grants, climate-smart agriculture and a women's skilling centre for caregivers.

pages.title: Get Involved — Boundless Gracia Children's Foundation
pages.description: Every way to stand with a child: sponsorship, medical care, caregiver livelihoods, the Mpara clinic appeal, volunteering, field weeks and partnership.

pages.description: Fund the consultation, the medicine, the referral transport and the follow-up visit for a child whose household could not have paid for any of them.

pages.title: Back a Caregiver — Boundless Gracia Children's Foundation
pages.description: Back a caregiver into a savings group, enterprise training and a start-up grant, so a family can provide for its own children.
